about: Draft slots that were scheduled and then forfeited, each supplied by a named provenance. A forfeited slot has NO selected player. Only the fields below are recorded: nothing else is known, and nothing may be added without a source (no violation, no offending owner or franchise, no penalty ruling date, no MFL transaction).

records.scheduled_slot_basis: MFL's own overall pick numbers run 47 (4.11) then 49 (5.01) in the 2018 draft results; 48 is the only overall number absent in that draft
